title: 苹果没做电视：却把299美元屏钉上墙，客厅控制权要换人？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Apple released a new line of smart home devices, including a new gadget called the HomeView.
segments.zh: 苹果发布全新智能家居设备，包括一款名为HomeView的新产品。

segments.en: A 299 display aimed at challenging Amazon and Google in the smart home market, joining us, Bloomberg, SmartGerman, who leads our coverage of Apple and consumer technology.
segments.zh: 这款299美元的显示屏旨在挑战亚马逊和谷歌在智能家居市场的地位。彭博社的SmartGerman负责苹果和消费科技报道，与我们连线。

segments.en: Tell me about the device. 299 dollars, what do I need to know? Yeah, it's a pretty good price. This is basically a home pod with a built-in display.
segments.zh: 介绍一下这款设备。299美元，我需要知道什么？价格相当不错。这基本上是一个带显示屏的HomePod。

segments.en: It has a new operating system called the HomeView software. And basically the way it works is six people in a home could walk up to it, and everyone will get to experience something different,
segments.zh: 它搭载了名为HomeView软件的新操作系统。基本工作原理是，家里六个人可以走到它面前，每个人都能获得不同的体验，

segments.en: something customized just for them. If I walk up to it, I'll see my music, my messages, my applications, if my wife walks up to it, she'll keep, she'll see her calendar appointment,
segments.zh: 专为他们定制的体验。如果我走到它面前，我会看到我的音乐、消息、应用；如果我妻子走过去，她会看到她的日历预约，

segments.en: she'll see her clock faces, she'll see her notes, calendars, and reminders. And so it's a pretty cool device, and it's going to give the Amazon Echo show a serious run for its money,
segments.zh: 她会看到她的表盘、笔记、日历和提醒。所以这是一款很酷的设备，它将给亚马逊Echo Show带来 serious 竞争，

segments.en: especially at the 299 price point. So it's interesting that there's actually two variants of it, right? There's the table top, and then there's a wall-mounted one. Both the same price,
segments.zh: 尤其是在299美元这个价位。有趣的是，它实际上有两个版本，对吧？有桌面版，还有壁挂版。两者价格相同，

segments.en: slightly different form factors. I think the table top just standard USB-C, right? But why did Apple do that? Why did they want optionality? Well, they wanted to fit people, however they wanted to
segments.zh: 外形略有不同。桌面版就是标准USB-C，对吧？但苹果为什么这么做？为什么想要可选性？因为他们想适应人们的不同使用方式。

segments.en: use this device. I mean, the Echo show, there's a lot of people who pin theirs on the wall. These were home devices, they can serve as a thermostat, can serve as a control panel. And just like you may
segments.zh: 我是说，Echo Show有很多人把它钉在墙上。这些是家居设备，可以作为恒温器，可以作为控制面板。就像你可能

segments.en: have an ADT security panel on your wall, you may want one of these instead, or in addition to, to control your thermostat, to control your lights, to see the weather, to do quick facetime calls.
segments.zh: 墙上有一个ADT安全面板，你可能想要一个这样的设备来替代或补充，控制恒温器、控制灯光、查看天气、快速进行FaceTime通话。
